name: WayriCAD Copper Balancer
description: Preview isolated copper thieving and local density balancing on saved PCB copies.
description_full: Local native KiCad 10 polygon geometry, eight patterns, per-layer density maps, clearances, keepouts and replacement. The PCM action opens an explicit saved-board workflow and writes a new board copy. Live IPC copper edits and KiCad 11 geometry are not yet supported.
